setup: apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential libpq-dev libyaml-dev libssl-dev zlib1g-dev libffi-dev libvips postgresql-client redis-tools

bash -o pipefail -c 'mkdir -p /opt/hostedtoolcache/Ruby/3.4.4 && curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://github.com/ruby/ruby-builder/releases/download/toolcache/ruby-3.4.4-ubuntu-24.04.tar.gz | tar -xz -C /opt/hostedtoolcache/Ruby/3.4.4 && for tool in ruby gem bundle bundler irb rake; do ln -sf /opt/hostedtoolcache/Ruby/3.4.4/x64/bin/$tool /usr/local/bin/$tool; done && /usr/local/bin/gem install bundler -v 2.6.9 --no-document'
warmup: bundle config set --local path vendor/bundle && bundle config set --local frozen true && bundle install --jobs 4 && npm ci
install: bundle config set --local path vendor/bundle && bundle config set --local frozen true && bundle install --jobs 4 && npm ci

db.cmd: docker start -a maybe-postgres || docker run --name maybe-postgres -e POSTGRES_USER -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD -v maybe-postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data -p 5432:5432 postgres:16

redis.cmd: docker start -a maybe-redis || docker run --name maybe-redis -v maybe-redis-data:/data -p 6379:6379 redis:7-alpine

web.cmd: timeout 120 sh -c 'until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -q; do sleep 1; done' && timeout 120 sh -c 'until redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 ping | grep -q PONG; do sleep 1; done' && bundle exec rails db:prepare && exec bundle exec rails server -b 0.0.0.0 -p "$PORT"

worker.cmd: timeout 180 sh -c 'until curl -fsS --max-time 2 -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3000/up; do sleep 1; done' && exec bundle exec sidekiq
